findings.title: Two Palestinians killed in Gaza, bringing today's death toll to eight
findings.source_type: Official Palestinian news agency; eyewitness reporting for Gaza City incident
findings.location: Gaza City, near MSF Belgium clinic and Al-Shifa Hospital
findings.affected_population_system: WAFA cites eyewitnesses reporting two Palestinians killed and several injured by a strike near the clinic. Civilian status, identities, and any damage or disruption to the clinic are unverified.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: killing two people and wounding several others.

bounded_discovery_context.method: Direct WAFA homepage discovery and linked article inspection after OCHA and WHO checks; compared with all 13 November 27 authenticated heartbeats and eight November 26 evening records.
bounded_discovery_context.novelty: Distinct reported evening incident, not the previously recorded Al-Rimal apartment or Bir al-Naaja vehicle strike.
bounded_discovery_context.caveat: Displayed publication time 10:57 PM November 27 lacks explicit timezone; exact event time unknown. Independent corroboration not established. Do not infer strike on the clinic or add aggregate totals to prior findings.

findings.title: Two Palestinians killed in Gaza, bringing today's death toll to eight
findings.location: Al-Mawasi, southwest of Rafah, southern Gaza Strip
findings.affected_population_system: WAFA reports one Palestinian fatally shot earlier that evening. Identity and civilian status unknown; potential overlap with other southern Gaza casualty reporting remains unresolved.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: another Palestinian was fatally shot by Israeli forces

bounded_discovery_context.method: Direct WAFA linked article and comparison with prior 13 November 27 heartbeats and WAFA 177357.
bounded_discovery_context.novelty: Newly reported fatal shooting in southwest Rafah, distinct as described from child wounded in Khan Younis and Rafah strike recovery.
bounded_discovery_context.caveat: Possible overlap with earlier AP Muwasi casualty report cannot be excluded; do not sum. No explicit timezone, exact event time or independent corroboration.
